reference.title: Typical structure
reference.shortdesc: A sample structure is provided below.

section.p: A sample structure is provided below.
section.codeblock: markdown docs/ ├── index.md # Home page ├── about.md ├── user-guide/ │ ├── getting-started.md │ └── configuration.md ├── api/ │ └── endpoints.md └── images/ └── diagram.png mkdocs.yml
section.p: MkDocs uses Python-Markdown (with extensions) to render Markdown. You can enable extensions in mkdocs.yml (such as markdown extensions for tables, code highlighting, admonitions, etc.). Notably, MkDocs Material (a popular theme) supports the Markdown Admonition syntax (!!! note or !!! warning) out of the box. There is no per-page YAML, so metadata like author or category is generally not used (except via plugins or HTML meta tags in the theme).
